name: dubai-setup-index
description: Dubai and UAE company setup data from Dubai Setup Index: compare free zones and the Dubai mainland route, check which free zones permit a business activity, and estimate setup costs with every unknown fee kept explicit. Every answer links to a sourced, dated page.

interface.longDescription:
Dubai Setup Index answers Dubai and UAE business setup and company formation questions with sourced, dated figures. Founders, freelancers and advisers use it to compare free zones with the Dubai mainland route, check which free zones license a business activity, and price a trade licence and visas before talking to anyone.

Look up any of 40+ UAE free zones for packages and starting prices by visa count, setup steps, documents, visas and renewal. Match a business to licensable activities and see which routes list them. Estimate an IFZA setup or its five-year costs, or a Dubai mainland licence from the official Invest in Dubai calculator. Compare routes side by side, and read setup notes and visa rules by nationality.

Every figure carries its source and the date it was checked. Facts that are not published stay unknown rather than becoming estimates, and cost estimates list what they leave out instead of hiding it in a total.

UAE only. Published prices and fees change; confirm with the authority before you file or pay. The plugin does not file anything or take payments: for IFZA, Ajman Free Zone, Meydan Free Zone and Dubai mainland it can draft a setup application that you review and approve on the Dubai Setup Index site, and the setup team (JustMove) then sends its own written quotation. It does not give legal, tax or immigration advice. A Dubai Setup Index account is required to connect.
capabilities: Free zone packages, prices and visa options
Business activities by free zone and mainland
IFZA setup and five-year cost estimates
Setup notes and visa rules by nationality
defaultPrompt: What does an IFZA licence with one visa cost, and what isn't included?
Which UAE free zones can license an accounting and bookkeeping business?
Free zone or Dubai mainland for a software company that needs two visas?

positive.description: Price one free zone at one visa
positive.prompt: What does an IFZA licence with one residence visa cost, and what isn't included in that price?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns IFZA's published one-visa starting price with its source and checked date, says it is a starting package price rather than a full setup total, and names the costs it excludes or that are not published instead of adding a total for them.

positive.description: Find where an activity can be licensed
positive.prompt: Which UAE free zones can license an accounting and bookkeeping business, and do I need any approvals?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the setup routes that catalogue accounting and bookkeeping with their activity codes and licence types, states whether a third-party approval applies, and treats any route marked not verified as unverified rather than unavailable.

positive.prompt: Estimate the Dubai mainland licence cost for a single-owner software design company with an annual office rent of AED 20,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Invest in Dubai calculator's licence estimate for a one-owner LLC with the software design activity at AED 20,000 rent (base fee plus the rent percentage), with its source and date, and lists rent itself, visas and approvals as separate unresolved costs rather than totalling them.

positive.prompt: Compare IFZA and Ajman Free Zone for a company that needs two visas.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows IFZA and Ajman Free Zone side by side: two-visa starting prices, licence and visa timelines, renewal and facility types, each with its source date, and marks cells that are not published as unknown.

positive.prompt: I'm a UK founder. What documents should I prepare, and are there UAE visa rules specific to my nationality?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the United Kingdom guide's document and attestation notes, then lists residence-visa rules that name the UK or apply to everyone with their status, flagging any reported rule as needing confirmation before applying.

negative.description: Filing and payment stay with the user and the setup team
negative.prompt: Register my company in IFZA for me and pay the fees.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not file or pay anything itself. Confirms the activity, visas and shareholders' nationalities, then may draft an application with start_application and give the user the approval link, explaining that nothing is shared until they approve and that the setup team sends a written quotation before any payment.

negative.prompt: How much corporate tax will I owe on AED 2 million profit from my free zone company?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not calculate a personal tax liability or give tax advice, and recommends a qualified tax adviser. It does not invent a figure the index does not publish.

negative.prompt: How do I set up a company in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia?
negative.expected_behavior: Says Dubai Setup Index covers UAE setup routes only and does not answer for Saudi Arabia, without inventing Saudi figures.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.4: The README says analytics never records the client name on a quote, and the Claude listing links support and terms. 1.2.3: README names both tools that save to the account (start_application, prepare_quote) and what each shares; privacy policy URL in the Claude manifest. 1.2.2: Listed as Dubai Setup Index under Business & Operations; adds a Codex plugin manifest. 1.2.0: Sourced, dated Dubai and UAE company-setup data in chat. Look up 40+ UAE free zones (packages and starting prices by visa count, setup steps, documents, visas and renewal); match a business to licensable activities by free zone and the Dubai mainland, with codes, approvals and the regulator a regulated activity needs; estimate an IFZA setup line by line or over five years, and a Dubai mainland licence from the official Invest in Dubai calculator; compare routes and setup scenarios side by side under the same assumptions; read setup notes and visa rules by nationality; plan a setup from a business type with a sourced requirements checklist; prepare a line-item IFZA quote for a client; and, for IFZA, Ajman Free Zone, Meydan Free Zone and Dubai mainland, draft a setup application that you approve on the Dubai Setup Index site. Unpublished fees stay unknown rather than estimated. Account limit messages state the limit and when it resets.
